title: kith-jmap: max_objects_in_get/set capability not enforced in handlers
description: build_session advertises max_objects_in_get=500 and max_objects_in_set=500. These are RFC 8620 §2 capability limits clients will use to size their requests. If the actual handlers in kith-chat accept more than 500 IDs without rejecting, the advertised limit is a lie. Need to audit ChatContact/get, Chat/get, Message/get for input-count enforcement.
